goal: Prevent data races when external mining clients concurrently read and submit block solutions over IPC
Provide total template fees directly so external mining clients do not need to sum individual fees
reviewability: All reviewer feedback has been addressed and the added regression test is in place
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by testing concurrent template access under TSAN (enirox001)
Rechecked after author added a functional test to exercise the race under TSAN (ismaelsadeeq, enirox001)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it fixes a thread safety hazard in the mining interface that can race during block submission
It also saves external mining clients from repeatedly transferring and summing transaction fees
